title: Latest reported figures: 1,294 confirmed dead
body: The confirmed death toll in Nepal has risen to 1,294, from 1,290, Onlinekhabar reports. The number of people listed missing has risen to 8,898, from 5,083, Khabarhub reports.
Where a report describes one district or one stretch of river rather than the national figure, it is not used here. Out of contact does not mean dead.
